diCards.warRage.name: War Rage
diCards.warRage.text: In Battle: your Troop gains +1 Strength.
diCards.warFury.name: War Fury
diCards.warFury.text: In Battle: your Troop gains +2 Strength.
diCards.bloodyBattle.name: Bloody Battle
diCards.bloodyBattle.text: In Battle: your Troop gains +1 Damage.
diCards.bloodbath.name: Bloodbath
diCards.bloodbath.text: In Battle: your Troop gains +2 Damage.
diCards.bronzeWall.name: Bronze Wall
diCards.bronzeWall.text: In Battle: your Troop gains +1 Defense.
diCards.ironWall.name: Iron Wall
diCards.ironWall.text: In Battle: your Troop gains +2 Defense
diCards.rainingFire.name: Raining Fire
diCards.rainingFire.text:
Remove 1 opponent Unit.
In Battle, during the Confirmation step: remove 1 opponent Unit from this Battle.
diCards.prayer.name: Prayer
diCards.prayer.text:
Gain 2☥.
In Battle: during the Confirmation step: gain 2☥.
diCards.enlistment.name: Enlistment
diCards.enlistment.text:
Add up to 2 Units spread between your Districts and/or your Troops.
In Battle, at the end of the Casualties step: Add up to 2 Units to your Troop.
diCards.manaDuplication.name: Mana Duplication
diCards.manaDuplication.text: In reaction to an opponent action: gain 1☥ + 1☥ per 2☥ they spent for this entire action.
diCards.transfer.name: Transfer
diCards.transfer.text: During your Movement action: teleport your Troop for free, wherever it stands, to a space containing an Obelisk.
diCards.openGates.name: Open Gates
diCards.openGates.text: During your Movement action: your Troop ignores the effects of 1 Wall.
diCards.veto.name: Veto
diCards.veto.text:
Cancel any effect of the DI card that have just been played.
A Veto card cannot be canceled by another Veto card.
diCards.escape.name: Escape
diCards.escape.text: When an opponent enters a space you control, no effect triggered by its entry is resolved and their Movement action ends immediately: no Battle Phase triggers, move your Troop to an adjacent empty space which is not an opponent District, this is not a Movement action.
diCards.swiftness.name: Swiftness
diCards.swiftness.text: During your Movement action: your Troop gains +1 Land move.
diCards.glory.name: Glory
diCards.glory.text: In Battle: during the Resolution step, gain 4☥ if you are the Champion.
diCards.divineMemory.name: Divine Memory
diCards.divineMemory.text: This card cannot be played in Battle. Add 1 card from the discard pile to your hand without revealing it. Then, shuffle the discard pile with the DI deck.
diCards.divineProtection.name: Divine Protection
diCards.divineProtection.text: In Battle: during the Casualties step, if you are the Champion, your Troop may not be removed by Damage coming from your opponent.
diCards.conscription.name: Conscription
diCards.conscription.text: In Battle: during the Casualties step, if you are the Champion, you may add up to 3 Units spread between your Districts and/ or your Troops.
diCards.snare.name: Snare
diCards.snare.text: In Battle: during the Confrontation step, when both players have revealed their cards, you may exchange the Battle card you played with the one you discarded face down during the War council step.
powerTiles.diamondPriest.name: Priest
powerTiles.diamondPriestess.name: Priestess
powerTiles.diamondPriestess.text: During your Buy a Power tile actions: the cost of the Power you are buying is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0).
powerTiles.diamondMagicalSupport.name: Magical Support
powerTiles.diamondMagicalSupport.text: During your Raise a Pyramid actions: the cost of each level is reduced by 1☥ (to a minimum of 0).
powerTiles.diamondHighPriest.name: High Priest
powerTiles.diamondHighPriest.text: In Night Phase: during the Prayer step, gain 2☥.
powerTiles.diamondDivineHunger.name: Divine Hunger
powerTiles.diamondDivineHunger.text: In Battle: during the Casualties step, gain 2☥ per opponent Unit you removed with your Damage.
powerTiles.diamondDivineBoon.name: Divine Boon
powerTiles.diamondDivineBoon.text: In Night Phase: during the Divine intervention step, draw 1 DI card.
powerTiles.diamondHandOfGod.name: Hand of God
powerTiles.diamondHandOfGod.text: In Night Phase: during the Awakening step, you may raise one of your Pyramids 1 level for free.
powerTiles.diamondVision.name: Vision
powerTiles.diamondVision.text: In Night Phase: during the Divine intervention step, draw 4 extra DI cards you add to your hand, then discard 4 DI cards.
powerTiles.diamondPriestOfThoeris.name: Priest of Thoeris
powerTiles.diamondPriestOfThoeris.text: In Battle: during the Resolution step, gain 4☥ if you are the Champion (either as an attacker, or a defender).
powerTiles.diamondDomination.name: Domination
powerTiles.diamondPriestOfRa.name: Priest of Ra
powerTiles.diamondPriestOfRa.text: Each time you spend at least 1☥: this cost is reduced by 1☥ (to a minimum of 0).
powerTiles.diamondPriestOfAmon.name: Priest of Amon
powerTiles.diamondPriestOfAmon.text:
When you buy this tile: gain 5☥.
In Night Phase: during the Prayer step, gain 5☥.
powerTiles.diamondTheMummy.name: The Mummy
powerTiles.diamondTheMummy.text:
The tied Troop gains: +1 Land move, +2 Strength.
In Night Phase: during the Divine intervention step, draw 1DI card.
powerTiles.diamondActOfGod.name: Act of God
powerTiles.rubyCharge.name: Charge!
powerTiles.rubyCharge.text: In Battle, when you are the attacker: your Troops gain +1 Strength.
powerTiles.rubyStargate.name: Stargate
powerTiles.rubyStargate.text: During your Movement actions: your Teleportation cost is reduced by 1☥ (to a minimum of 0).
powerTiles.rubyPriestOfMafdet.name: Priest of Mafdet
powerTiles.rubyPriestOfMafdet.text: During your Movement actions: your Troops gain +1 Land move.
powerTiles.rubyCarnage.name: Carnage
powerTiles.rubyCarnage.text: In Battle: your Troops gain +1 Damage.
powerTiles.rubyWrrytStorm.name: Wrryt Storm
powerTiles.rubyWrrytStorm.text: Take back all your Battle cards in hand, then remove from the game 1 of them and replace it with the special +3 Strength / 3 Damage Battle card. The removed card is kept secret.
powerTiles.rubySappers.name: Sappers
powerTiles.rubySappers.text: During your Movement actions: your Troops ignore the effects of 1 Wall.
powerTiles.rubyPortalOfThoth.name: Portal of Thoth
powerTiles.rubyPortalOfThoth.text: During your Movement actions: your Troops gain +1 Teleportation. Your Teleportations may be done from a space containing an Obelisk.
powerTiles.rubyRoyalScarab.name: Royal Scarab
powerTiles.rubyRoyalScarab.text: The tied Troop gains: +2 Land moves, +2 Strength.
powerTiles.rubyBladesOfNeith.name: Blades of Neith
powerTiles.rubyBladesOfNeith.text: In Battle: your Troops gain +1 Strength.
powerTiles.rubyDivineWound.name: Divine Wound
powerTiles.rubyDivineWound.text: In Battle: at the end of the Confrontation step, you may discard DI cards from your hand: for each card discarded this way, your Troop gains +1 Strength.
powerTiles.rubyDomination.name: Domination
powerTiles.rubyGiantScorpion.name: Giant Scorpion
powerTiles.rubyGiantScorpion.text: The tied Troop gains: +1 Land move, +2 Strength, +2 Damage.
powerTiles.rubyInitiative.name: Initiative
powerTiles.rubyInitiative.text: During your Movement actions, if your Troops enter a space containing an opponent Troop: remove 2 Units from the opponent Troop. If there is no opponent Troop left, the Battle does not trigger and you may continue your Movement action.
powerTiles.rubyPhoenix.name: Phoenix
powerTiles.rubyPhoenix.text: The tied Troop gains: +1 Land move, +2 Strength. During your Movement actions: the tied Troop ignores the effects of 1 Wall.
powerTiles.rubyActOfGod.name: Act of God
powerTiles.sapphireRecruitingScribe.name: Recruiting Scribe
powerTiles.sapphireRecruitingScribe.text: During your Recruit actions: recruit up to 2 free Units.
powerTiles.sapphireDefense.name: Defense!
powerTiles.sapphireDefense.text: In Battle, when you are the defender: your Troops gain +1 Strength.
powerTiles.sapphireLegion.name: Legion
powerTiles.sapphireAncestralElephant.tex: The tied Troop gains: +1 Land move, +1 Strength, +1 Defense.
powerTiles.sapphireShetywBarrier.name: Shetyw Barrier
powerTiles.sapphireShetywBarrier.text: Take back all your Battle cards in hand, then remove from the game 1 of them and replace it with the special +3 Strength / 3 Defense Battle card. The removed card is kept secret.
powerTiles.sapphireDeepDesertSnake.name: Deep Desert Snake
powerTiles.sapphireDeepDesertSnake.text: The tied Troop gains: +1 Land move. In Battle: effects and bonuses of the opponent Creature are ignored.
powerTiles.sapphireShieldsOfNeith.name: Shields of Neith
powerTiles.sapphireShieldsOfNeith.text: In Battle: your Troops gain +1 Defense.
powerTiles.sapphireDefensiveVictory.name: Defensive Victory
powerTiles.sapphireDefensiveVictory.text: In Battle, when you are the defender: during the Reward step, if you are the Champion and your Troop still has at least 1 Unit, gain 1 Battle VP.
powerTiles.sapphirePrescience.name: Prescience
powerTiles.sapphirePrescience.text: In Battle: during the War Council step, your opponent reveals the Battle card they are playing before you choose your Battle cards.
powerTiles.sapphireDomination.name: Domination
powerTiles.sapphireReinforcements.name: Reinforcements
powerTiles.sapphireReinforcements.text: When you buy this tile: you may add up to 4 Units spread between your Districts and/or your Troops. In Night Phase: during the Awakening step, you may add up to 4 Units spread between your Districts and/or your Troops.
powerTiles.sapphireSphinx.name: Sphinx
powerTiles.sapphireSphinx.text: 1 Sphinx VP. The tied Troop gains: +2 Strength.
powerTiles.sapphireDivineWill.name: Divine Will
powerTiles.sapphireDivineWill.text: Take 1 gold Action token if you do not have any. Play your gold Action token on the icon on top of your pyramid: you may take either a Movement action, or a Recruit action.
powerTiles.sapphireActOfGod.name: Act of God
powerTiles.onyxMercenaries.name: Mercenaries
powerTiles.onyxMercenaries.text: When you buy this tile: place the 3 Units from clan 1 in your City. They are considered as Units from your faction.
powerTiles.onyxLocalRecruitment.name: Local Recruitment
powerTiles.onyxLocalRecruitment.text: During your Recruit actions: you may spread the recruited Units between your Districts and/or your Troops.
powerTiles.onyxRiteOfAqen.name: Rite of Aqen
powerTiles.onyxRiteOfAqen.text: Take 1 gold Action token if you do not have any. Play your gold Action token on the icon on top of your pyramid: take a Pray action.
powerTiles.onyxHonorInBattle.name: Honor in Battle
powerTiles.onyxHonorInBattle.text: In Battle: at the end of the Casualties step, gain 1☥ for each of your Units removed by your opponent’s Damage.
powerTiles.onyxDedicationToBattle.name: Dedication to Battle
powerTiles.onyxDedicationToBattle.text: During your Movement actions, when your Troops enter a space controlled by an opponent Troop: gain 2☥ even if no Battle occurs.
powerTiles.onyxKhnumsSphinx.name: Khnum’s Sphinx
powerTiles.onyxKhnumsSphinx.text: The tied Troop gains: +1 Land move, +1 Strength. During opponents Movement actions, a Troop must spend 2 extra ☥ to enter the space controlled by Khnum’s Sphinx.
powerTiles.onyxTwinCeremony.name: Twin Ceremony
powerTiles.onyxTwinCeremony.text: Take 1 gold Action token if you do not have any. Play your gold Action token on the icon on top of your pyramid: take a Buy a Power tile action you have already played during this Round to buy a Power tile which cost is raised 1 extra ☥.
powerTiles.onyxGriffinSphinx.name: Griffin Sphinx
powerTiles.onyxGriffinSphinx.text: The tied Troop gains: +1 Teleportation, +2 Strength. Your Teleportations with the tied Troop may be done from a space containing an Obelisk.
powerTiles.onyxForcedMarch.name: Forced March
powerTiles.onyxForcedMarch.text: Take 1 gold Action token if you do not have any. Play your gold Action token on the icon on top of your pyramid: take a Movement action during which you cannot use any Teleportation.
powerTiles.onyxDeadlyTrap.name: Deadly Trap
powerTiles.onyxDeadlyTrap.text: During opponents Movement actions, when a Troop enters a space controlled by one of your Troops: remove 1 unit from this opponent Troop before resolving the Battle. If there’s no opponent Troop left, the Battle is not resolved.
powerTiles.onyxDomination.name: Domination
powerTiles.onyxAmmoutTheSoulDevourer.tex:
The tied Troop gains: +1 Land move, +2 Strength. The tied Troop cancels any Damage it receives outside of any Battle.
In Battle: during the Reward step, if you are the Champion and you have removed at least 2 Units from the opponent Troop with you Damage, gain 1 Battle VP.
powerTiles.onyxBestialFury.name: Bestial Fury
powerTiles.onyxBestialFury.text:
During your Movement actions: your Troops gain +1 Land move.
In Battle: your Troops gain +1 Strength and +1 Damage.
powerTiles.onyxDivineMight.name: Divine might
powerTiles.onyxDivineMight.text: In Day Phase: each time an effect other than this one makes you gain at least 1☥: gain 1 extra ☥.
powerTiles.onyxActOfGod.name: Act of God
powerTiles.onyxActOfGod.text: Take an additional silver Action Token. It must be placed and played at the same time as a regular token.
